name: pipeline-percent-lock
description: Fractional entry sizing via percentAmountToLock: funding 1000, percentAmountToLock 50, zero fees, buy@100 then sell@110. The entry is sized to 50% of the available funds, so the round trip trades 5 base (500 quote) instead of the all-in 10. Because the percentage scales the amount actually committed to the entry, the yield cost basis is the 500 spent, not the full 1000: input 500, output 550, pnl +50, final equity 1000 - 500 + 550 = 1050. Pins that fractional sizing is honoured end to end without a separate backtest setting.
